ways_to_save: Set a firm monthly budget for peer lending so you only lend what you can comfortably afford to wait for.
Purchase airtime using weekly or monthly data/minute bundles on your provider network to stretch your KES 250 further.
Prepare breakfast at home or carry a light snack before long trips to Kitui to avoid buying food on the go.
